PAKISTAN RAILWAYS POLICE RULES, 1980
PAKISTAN RAILWAYS POLICE RULES, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 11, 18th August
1980]
S. R. O. 854 (1)/80.‑In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 17 of the Pakistan Railways Police Act, 1977 (VII of
1977); the Federal Govern ment is pleased to make the following rules, namely :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These rules may
be called the Pakistan Railways Police Rules, 1980.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.‑In these rules, unless there is
anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "Act" means the Pakistan Railways Police
Act, 1977 (VII of 1977);
(b) "Appendix" means an appendix to these rules;
(c) "appointing authority", in relation to a
member or ministerial staff, means the .Inspector‑General or an officer
to whom the power is delegated by the Inspector‑General under subsection
(1) of section 8 and in other cases the Federal Government;
(d) "Departmental Promotion Committee" means a
committee consti tuted under rule 11 for the purpose of making selection for
appointment, promotion or transfer to posts under the Pakistan Railways Police;
(e) "Grade" means the National Scale of Pay in
which a post or group of posts is placed;
(f) "ministerial staff" means a person other
than an officer or member; and
(g) "section" means section of the Act.
3. Constitution of the Pakistan Railways Police.‑(1)
The Pakistan Railways Police shall be constituted by transfer of persons
referred to in section 5 and by appointment of persons under section 7 and
section 8.
(2) The Pakistan Railways Police shall consist of two
wings, namely :‑
(a) Investigation and Prosecution Wing; and
(b) Preventive Wing.
(3) The Investigation and Prosecution Wing shall consist
of two groups, namely, Investigation Group and Prosecution Group, and, comprise
of persons referred to in clause (a) of subsection (I) of section 5 and shall
also include persons appointed or transferred to it.
(4) Preventive Wing shall comprise of persons referred to
in clause (b) of subsection (1) of section (5) and shall also include persons
appointed or transferred to it.
4. Headquarters and Divisional offices.‑(1) The
Pakistan Railways Police shall have its Headquarters at Lahore and Divisional
offices at the places specified in column (2) of Appendix I with territorial
limits specified in column (3) thereof.
(2) The members and ministerial staff posted at Walton
Training School, Lahore, shall, until otherwise directed by the Federal
Government by a notification in the official Gazette, be within the administrative
control of the Workshops Division, Mughalpura.
5. Transfer and appointment under .section S.‑(1)
The persons holding any rank or post in or under the Railway Police of the
Provinces and the persons holding any rank or post in the Railway Watch and Ward
as specified in column (1) and column (2), respectively, of Appendix 11 on
transfer to the Pakistan Railways Police under subsection (1) of section 5
stand appointed to the corresponding ranks and posts specified in column (3) of
that Appendix, subject to the following conditions, namely :‑
(a) The transfer shall not alter the pay of the
transferees to their disadvantage;
(b) the service rendered by the transferees shall count
towards leave, pension, provident fund and other benefits applicable to Railways
employees, and
(c) the transferees shall be paid from the Railways Budget
from the date of their transfer to the Pakistan Railways Police.
6. Methods of appointment.‑Appointment to the posts
under the Pakistan Railways Police shall be made by any of the following
methods, namely :‑
(a) by direct appointment;
(b) by promotion; or
(c) by transfer from other Departments of the Federal
Government or a Provincial Government.
7. Appointment under section 7.‑The qualifications
and other conditions for appointment to the posts specified in section 7 shall
be such as may be determined by the Federal Government from time to time.
